observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage with dark background, performance lighting
observation.dancers: mixed group of men and women, several couples
observation.formation_and_space: group arranged in a staggered formation across the stage
observation.posture: upright and proud torso, knees slightly bent, weight centered or shifting dynamically
observation.footwork: rapid steps, shuffling or bounding patterns synchronized with the heavy rhythm; exact foot placement occluded by long garments
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held out to the sides at shoulder height with elbows bent, hands posed with fingers slightly curved; men have arms extended or framing the torso
observation.hips_and_torso: torso held upright and still with slight upper body turns and expressive framing
observation.partnering: none in physical contact, dancers perform in proximity as an ensemble
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright standing level with dynamic turns and leaps executed by individual dancers
observation.costume_and_props: traditional Georgian long red coats with cartridge loops (chokha) for men and women, head coverings for women, belts at the waist
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details and weight transfers are obscured by long traditional costumes and fast camera action

signature_moments.what: dancers hold poses with arms extended sideways and heads turned sharply, holding striking postures while the music drives the rhythm
